The '''Hook Talons''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] consisting of twenty-eight [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] and heavy [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] that preyed on [[Starship/Legends|starships]] along the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]<ref name="Codex" /> [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Time" /> However, when the Hook Talons [[Battle between the Aurora and the Hook Talons|engaged]] the [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] [[Aurora (Valor-class)|''Aurora'']], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] patrol craft assigned to the Rimma Trade Route, they were heavily outgunned despite their superior numbers, and the ''Aurora'' wiped out every one of the Hook Talons' ships, earning it [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] fame.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hook Talons were mentioned in the Codex entry for the ''Aurora'' in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
